name: Maysie & Henry Hill Charitable Trust: Environmental Groups Round

funder.name: The Maysie & Henry Hill Charitable Trust

summary: Grants for local Kapiti Coast environmental groups running specific projects that enhance the local natural environment. Groups need not be registered charities. Applications are called for yearly around November from 2026.

eligibility.rule: Be a Kāpiti Coast environmental group
